MRPL SOP Section 1: Scope and Applicability.
Governs centrifugal slurry pumps (P-101A/B) in the primary desalter and crude distillation unit. Standard operating speed is 1480 RPM.

MRPL SOP Section 4.2: Mechanical Vibration Thresholds.
Under ISO 10816-3, baseline vibration limit for rigid foundation pumps is 2.8 mm/s RMS (Zone A). Action Threshold (Zone B/C Boundary) is strictly 4.5 mm/s RMS. Any pump measuring above 4.5 mm/s RMS requires immediate maintenance review and scheduled bearing replacement within 72 hours.

MRPL SOP Section 5.1: Mechanical Seal Maintenance & Leakage Criteria.
Primary face weeping shall not exceed 5 drops/minute. Weeping exceeding this limit warrants seal cartridge replacement with Plan 53B pressurized barrier fluid inspection.

CDU-1 P&ID Standard Instrument Tags:
PT-101: Suction pressure transmitter (Range: 0-5 bar).
PT-102: Discharge pressure transmitter (Range: 0-25 bar).
FT-101: Ultrasonic flow transmitter (Rated: 150 m3/h).

CDU-1 Piping Configuration:
P-101A and P-101B are piped in 100% duty standby configuration with motorized isolation valves MOV-101 and MOV-102. PSV-102 provides thermal overpressure relief setat 16.5 bar.

API 610 Section 6.1: Hydraulic Design.
Pumps must operate within the Preferred Operating Region (70% to 120% of Best Efficiency Point). Minimum continuous stable flow (MCSF) is 30% of BEP.

API 610 Section 6.10: Bearing Temperature Limits.
Hydrodynamic and rolling-element bearing temperatures must not exceed 82°C (180°F) under maximum design operating load in ambient conditions.

API 510 Section 4: Non-Destructive Examination (NDE).
Ultrasonic thickness measurements must be performed at minimum 4 quadrant points around nozzle intersections and shell high-stress zones.

MANGALORE REFINERY AND PETROCHEMICALS LIMITED (MRPL)
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE: SOP-MECH-4.2
TITLE: Centrifugal Pump Vibration Severity, Mechanical Seal Inspection, and Maintenance Overhaul Protocol
DOCUMENT CODE: MRPL-SOP-MECH-4.2-REV4
EFFECTIVE DATE: 15-JAN-2025
GOVERNING UNIT: Mechanical Maintenance & Asset Integrity Division

Mechanical Maintenance & Asset Integrity Division

1. PURPOSE & SCOPE:
This SOP establishes mandatory vibration velocity thresholds, seal inspection criteria, and overhaul triggers for all API 610 centrifugal process pumps operating across CDU-1, VDU, and Phase-3 units.

2. VIBRATION THRESHOLDS (ISO 10816-3 / API 610 CLASS II/III MACHINERY):
- SECTION 4.2: PERMISSIBLE VIBRATION LIMITS & OVERHAUL MANDATE:
  * Zone A (Newly Commissioned / Normal): RMS Velocity <= 2.8 mm/s. Continuous routine monitoring.
  * Zone B (Acceptable for Long-term Operation): RMS Velocity 2.8 mm/s to 4.5 mm/s. Safe continuous operation.
  * Zone C (Restricted Operation / Priority Maintenance): RMS Velocity 4.5 mm/s to 7.1 mm/s.
    - MANDATORY REQUIREMENT: When overall RMS vibration exceeds 4.5 mm/s (such as observed on Pump P-101 at 4.8 mm/s), an official Approval Note must be prepared within 24 hours to authorize bearing replacement, shaft alignment check, and dynamic rebalancing.
  * Zone D (Unacceptable / Emergency Trip): RMS Velocity > 7.1 mm/s. Immediate planned shutdown to prevent catastrophic impeller failure.

3. BEARING TEMPERATURE THRESHOLDS:
- Normal Operating Range: 55°C to 75°C.
- Alarm Threshold: 80°C.
- Trip Threshold: 90°C.

- Alarm Threshold: 80°C.
- Trip Threshold: 90°C.

4. MECHANICAL SEAL INSPECTION CRITERIA:
- Allowable primary face leakage for non-hazardous slurry services: <= 5 drops/minute (dry weeping).
- Continuous liquid stream or weeping exceeding 5 drops/minute requires immediate seal cartridge overhaul and barrier fluid flush verification.

5. APPROVAL WORKFLOW FOR OVERHAUL:
Every overhaul request exceeding 4.5 mm/s vibration or mechanical seal replacement must be documented in a 3-tier authorized Approval Note:
- Tier 1: Prepared by Lead Reliability Engineer
- Tier 2: Verified by Superintending Maintenance Engineer
- Tier 3: Approved by Chief General Manager (Technical)

MRPL SAFETY STANDARD: EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN VALVES (ESD-101)
ESD-101 must close within 2.5 seconds upon activation of High-High Pressure Alarm (PAHH-101).

MRPL REFINERY FLARING SYSTEM MANUAL
Maximum smokeless flaring rate is 120 tons/hour.
